newsitem.title: USA: Clarcor sees FY97 EPS dilution for United.
newsitem.headline: Clarcor sees FY97 EPS dilution for United.

text.p: Clarcor Inc said Friday it completed its acquisition of United Air Specialists Inc and expects the purchase to dilute fiscal 1997 earnings by about $0.03 to $0.05 a share.

The company said it also expects to take a $3 million pretax charge for the purchase in its first quarter ending February 1997. After fiscal 1997, Clarcor said it expects the merger to be accretive to earnings.
Clarcor said it issued about 1,209,302 shares of common stock in the acquisition, bringing its total number of outstanding shares to about 16,120,000.

"Clarcor expects the acquisition, which has been structured as a statuatory merger using pooling-of-interests accounting treatment, will dilute earnings in fiscal 1997 by about $0.03 to $0.05 per share and will be accretive to earnings thereafter," it said in a release.

In September, Clarcor, which provides filtration products, said it had agreed to a stock merger with United under which each fully diluted share of United Air would be converted into 0.36986 share of Clarcor.
Clarcor said the acquisition will expand its environmental and industrial air filtration operations, its fastest growing sector.

"We now have, for the first time, the ability to provide customers a full product offering from an initial installation of a complete industrial air cleaning system to comprehensive aftermarket filter replacements and ongoing service and maintenance," Larry Gloyd, chairman and chief executive of Clarcor, said in a statement.
Shares of Clarcor were off 5/8 at 22-1/2.
